remaining_doubts: 2832 (5-79, Left Hand with Short Pin): L is printed 1.500” although the right hand short-pin 2839 shows .750” and the 10 series short-pin 2830 shows .500”; kept as printed, possible catalog typo.
2833 (5-80, Left Hand with Long Pin): weight printed .134 lb, same as short-pin 2832, while the right hand long-pin 2840 is .140 lb; kept as printed.
2101/2102/2103 (and -Black): series badge printed as 10 to 15; recorded as series ["15"] only, per the no-10 rule.
dimension_notes on 2098 and the economy hinges are read from the drawings; letters H, J, K, L (2098) and D, E, H, J (economy) are only described generally.
